comparison_target.name: Celonis Process Intelligence Platform
comparison_target.basis: Publicly documented platform capabilities, used only as an external comparison boundary; vendor claims are not treated as independent proof of performance.

claim_policy.admission_rule: ALIVE only when every required capability has machine-observed ALIVE standing on the exact candidate SHA and every external-assurance requirement has current third-party evidence. Functional architecture similarity alone is insufficient.

capabilities.evidence: OCEL 2.0 objects/events/relationships plus real rust4pm object-centric discovery/conformance paths.
capabilities.falsifier: A real object-centric trace cannot be represented, queried, or consumed by the process-mining engine.

capabilities.evidence: Real DFG/POWL discovery exists over rust4pm and is exercised by current qualification suites.
capabilities.falsifier: A real reference event log cannot produce a process model without a mock or hand-coded expected model.

capabilities.evidence: Real alignment and fitness checking detects missing/reordered activities and emits deviations.
capabilities.falsifier: A deliberately deviant observed trace aligns at zero cost or emits no deviation.

capabilities.evidence: BRCE writes durable beam4pm-brce/v1 receipts containing OCEL events; ReceiptChain independently re-verifies ordered on-disk consequence history.
capabilities.falsifier: A process restart or fresh reader cannot reconstruct the verified action history from durable receipts.

capabilities.evidence: PowlConformance.conform_observe_replan/6 consumes real conformance evidence and can force bounded DfCM/Ferroplan replanning.
capabilities.falsifier: Changing conformance evidence cannot change reuse/replan behavior or its evidence hashes.

capabilities.evidence: The enterprise court takes live Ferroplan session steps, maps them to graph-admitted planning_action values, crosses BeamPM.Actuation BRCE, and advances the planner only after observed success.
capabilities.falsifier: A planner-selected action can execute without graph admission/receipt, or a successful repaired plan cannot be executed through BRCE.

capabilities.evidence: Hash-chained consequence receipts and deterministic plan-lineage evidence are independently replayable.
capabilities.falsifier: Tampering/reordering is accepted or replay cannot bind the executed consequence to the repaired planning episode.

capabilities.evidence: Real HTTP OCEL event/object ingestion exists, but enterprise connector breadth and continuous external-source coverage are not established.
capabilities.falsifier: The admitted HTTP ingestion route cannot receive and decode a real OCEL event/object.

capabilities.required_proof: Published reproducible load/query benchmark at Fortune-5-relevant scale, including at least billion-record-class data, p50/p95/p99 latency, ingestion throughput, resource use, failure recovery, and scale-out behavior.
capabilities.implementation_target: Partitioned columnar/object-event storage plus native/vectorized query execution and a repeatable large-scale benchmark court.

capabilities.required_proof: Versioned connector catalog with production qualification for major ERP/CRM/data platforms and connector contract tests.
capabilities.implementation_target: OTP-supervised connector SDK, CDC/batch source contracts, canonical OCEL/object mapping packs, and reusable connector certification fixtures.

capabilities.required_proof: Observed incremental/streaming ingestion plus zero-copy or pushdown access to governed lakehouse/object-store sources with freshness and consistency receipts.
capabilities.implementation_target: Kafka/CDC ingestion lane plus governed Parquet/lakehouse query adapters with provenance-bound snapshots.

capabilities.required_proof: Privacy-bounded desktop/task event capture, task discovery, process correlation, and replay qualification.
capabilities.implementation_target: Separate consented endpoint event collector projecting task evidence into OCEL without granting actuation authority.

capabilities.required_proof: SSO/OIDC or SAML, SCIM lifecycle, RBAC/ABAC, tenant/data-pool isolation, audit logs, negative authorization tests, and break-glass controls.
capabilities.implementation_target: Identity/tenant control plane with policy-as-data, row/object scope enforcement, and adversarial authorization courts.

capabilities.required_proof: Multi-node failover, rolling upgrade, backup/restore, RPO/RTO, load shedding, chaos tests, and published SLO/error-budget evidence.
capabilities.implementation_target: OTP cluster deployment profile plus replicated durable stores, disaster-recovery runbooks, chaos qualification, and SLO receipts.

capabilities.required_proof: Current independent security/compliance attestations appropriate to target customers (for example SOC 2 Type II / ISO 27001 as applicable), plus penetration-test and vulnerability-management evidence.
capabilities.implementation_target: Security control mapping and continuous evidence collection; third-party certification itself cannot be manufactured by code.

capabilities.required_proof: Production-grade process explorer, KPI/conformance views, root-cause analysis, value/opportunity views, governed action surfaces, accessibility and usability qualification.
capabilities.implementation_target: Read-only-first process intelligence UI over canonical query APIs, then explicitly admitted operational actions.

capabilities.evidence: Ontology-backed semantic types, process contracts, planning policy and evidence exist; a broad reusable enterprise process-knowledge catalog and KPI/opportunity layer is not yet demonstrated.
capabilities.required_proof: Reusable cross-process knowledge packs with provenance, KPIs, business rules, semantic mappings, versioning, and measurable reuse across independent domains.
Separately deployable/licensed product boundary, tenant lifecycle, entitlements, metering, upgrades, isolation and admin operations.
capabilities.implementation_target: Close the README-declared beam4pm_pro product-boundary, distribution/upgrade and control-plane gaps.
